content: The last row is the model trained on all 5k abstracts with crowd annotations. Its F1 score is lower than either expert model trained on only 20% of data, suggesting that expert annotations should be collected whenever possible. Again the crowd model on complete data has higher precision than expert models but its recall is much lower.
